name: ListStacks

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to perform a fuzzy search by stack name
parameters.help_zh: 关键字，按照资源栈名称模糊搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The stack status.
| Name | Description |
|------|------|
| Creating | Being created. |
| Created | Created. |
| Waiting | Waiting for deployment. |
| Deploying | Being deployed. |
| Deployed | Deployed. |
| Errored | Deployment failed. |
| Deleting | Being deleted. |
| Deleted | Deleted. |
| DeleteFailed | Deletion failed. |
| DetectTriggered | Drift detection triggered. |
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈状态
| 名称 | 描述 |
|------|------|
| Creating | 创建中 |
| Created | 创建完成 |
| Waiting | 等待部署中 |
| Deploying | 部署中 |
| Deployed | 部署完成 |
| Errored | 部署失败 |
| Deleting | 删除中 |
| Deleted | 已删除 |
| DeleteFailed | 删除失败 |
| DetectTriggered | 偏差检测触发成功 |
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of results returned per page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的结果数量。默认值：20，最小值：1，最大值：200
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. This parameter is empty if no more pages are available
parameters.help_zh: 分页Token，没有下一页则为空
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. Default value: 100. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 最大返回数量，默认值：100，最大值：200
parameters.name: max_results

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results returned

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token. This parameter is empty if no more pages are available
nextToken.description_zh: 分页Token，没有下一页则为空

createTime.description_en: The creation time in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
createTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

source.description_en:
The creation source. Valid values:
OSS: a template stored in Object Storage Service (OSS).
IAC_SERVICE_MODULE: a template created in the automation service console
source.description_zh:
创建来源，取值
OSS ：通过OSS对象存储的模板
IAC_SERVICE_MODULE ： 自动化服务台中创建的模板

sourcePath.description_en:
The path value of the configuration source. The value cannot exceed 1000 characters.
If the source is OSS, the value is in the format oss::<file link> and must be a zip file. Example: oss::https://terraform-pipeline.oss-eu-central-1.aliyuncs.com/code.zip
If the source is IAC_SERVICE_MODULE, the value is a template ID. Example: mod-xxxxx
sourcePath.description_zh:
配置来源的路径值，不超过 1000 个字符
来源为 OSS 时，取值为 oss::<文件链接>，必须为 zip 文件，例如 oss::https://terraform-pipeline.oss-eu-central-1.aliyuncs.com/code.zip
来源为 IAC_SERVICE_MODULE 时，取值为<模板Id>，例如: mod-xxxxx

stackId.description_en: The stack ID, which is the unique identifier generated after the stack is created
stackId.description_zh: StackId，Stack 创建后的唯一标识

stackName.description_en: The stack name (deprecated). Use name instead
